directive.thread_id: film repository port 2026-11-05, lane film-tools, sub-lane slate: a few seconds of sound, or one frame, from a camera file in cloud storage
directive.quote: Finish the port of the film repository so it can be retired: move each job to its correct home, porting the correct parts one to one and never rebuilding from scratch what already worked; move the code byte for byte, then make what it fixed arguments and settings.

targets.baseline_commit_message: pull-a-time-window-from-a-stored-camera-file: a film's byte-range audio and frame puller, moved byte for byte

preserve: top-level boxes walked by range up to and including moov, and a sparse copy with every box header and the whole moov
ffprobe names the audio packets inside the window; only those ranges (joined within GAP) are read
the wav starts with silence up to from (adelay), so second N of the wav is second N of the file
frame mode reads the one keyframe packet at or before the second
allowed_deltas: the reader command, store, account, credentials and gap are the person's list:settings row or request keys
the frame probe passes -fflags +noparse+nofillin, so ffmpeg keeps the file's own key flags in the sparse copy (the old probe found no keyframe)
reads and bytes counted and answered as one JSON result
banned_substitutions: an account id, store path or reader path written in code
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it. The second source (the file's first 29 lines: its description and imports) is listed for retention; the lines between the two, the person's storage account id, store and reader path, are not ported.
